issues.article_text: A Microsoft anunciou o Agent 365, um plano de controle centralizado para governança de agentes de IA que chega em 1º de maio — 80% das Fortune 500 já usam agentes.
issues.detail: Agent 365 was announced on March 9, 2026 as part of the Microsoft 365 E7 Frontier Suite launch. The SiliconANGLE article from March 22 (used as primary source) was covering RSA security details, not the original announcement. The product itself is 13 days old.

issues.article_text: a israelense XTEND fechou um acordo de US$11 milhões com a indiana Rayonix para fabricar UAVs com IA localmente
issues.detail: The deal was announced via GlobeNewsWire press release on March 16, 2026 by parent company JFB (NASDAQ: JFB). Coverage by The Week (March 18) and ChannelIAM (March 19) followed. The research.json sources from March 20-22 are delayed coverage, not fresh news.
